mapper.select: SELECT hourly_rate FROM coaches WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND delete_flag = 0

mapper.select: SELECT c.user_id, u.name, u.gender, u.birth_date, c.level, c.hourly_rate, c.photo_url, c.awards, u.phone, u.email, c.max_students, c.is_approved, c.create_time FROM coaches c JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.user_id = #{coachId} AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND u.delete_flag = 0 AND c.is_approved = 1
